action_items: Optional cleanup: any leftover TEST_iter20_* skippers / boats / traversées (the test suite cleans up after itself, but if a run was aborted, db.skippers.delete_many({'name': {'$regex': '^TEST_iter20_'}}) and db.bateaux.delete_many({'name': {'$regex': '^TEST_iter20_'}}).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:3503 — Bateau.fuel_litres_per_trip is bounded 0..2000 with default=0; BateauUpdate mirror is Optional. Backfill at server.py:3565 idempotently sets the field on legacy boats. Clean.
server.py:3534-3546 — Skipper / SkipperUpdate models with status Literal['actif','inactif'] and name min_length=2 — solid.

server.py:3940-3966 PATCH /staff/traversees/{tid} — status guard (must be 'programmé'), depart_time normalization (upper + ':'→'H'), and skipper_clear vs skipper_id semantics are correctly mutually-exclusive. depart_time empty-string is also handled.
server.py:3969-3991 DELETE /staff/traversees/{tid} — cascade-deletes child return leg only when child.status is in (None, 'programmé'). traversee_passengers also cleaned. Correct.

server.py:5247-5253 POST /staff/skippers — case-insensitive duplicate check via regex anchor. WARNING: name is interpolated raw into a regex; a malicious skipper name containing regex metachars (e.g., `.*`) could trigger ReDoS or match unintended entries. Recommend re.escape(name_clean). Low-risk since route is staff-only but worth a one-line fix.
server.py:5288-5300 DELETE /staff/skippers — admin-only (correct per spec). Detaches from programmé traversées before deletion. Good.
server.py:3892-3935 create_traversee — skipper_id must be 'actif' (404 otherwise). Return leg inherits skipper unless return_skipper_id is explicitly provided. Matches spec.
server.py:8325-8385 stats/advanced fleet block — counts only status='terminé' for target year, splits aller/retour, multiplies litres correctly. Test verified math.

StaffEmbarquement.jsx — all data-testids present (skippers-section, new-skipper-name/phone/license, add-skipper-btn, new-crossing-skipper, edit/delete-traversee-* and edit-traversee-skipper in modal). Manager-only buttons gated on isManager && status==='programmé'.
StaffRevenue.jsx — fleet-stats table renders one row per boat with fuel_litres_per_trip, trips, litres.
